title: A repeat study found no quiz edge for handwritten notes
body: In a 2021 study, 142 people watched a lecture. Those using laptops wrote more words and copied more of the lecture verbatim. On an immediate quiz, the researchers found no clear advantage for those who wrote by hand.
takeaway: When comparing note-taking methods, check what you can recall afterwards as well as how much you wrote.
visual: an open notebook and a laptop with a blank screen side by side on a lecture desk
